schema: Design4 geometry inputs (role: input unless noted). Lengths in mm/um as named.
purpose: Does halving the PurcellReadout hammer stub (153.5 -> 75 um) keep the Q3D circuit model and HFSS driven S21 in agreement?

substrate.source: Design5 / Design6 PurcellReadout channels (SI_EPS 11.5, 16/9 um CPW)

cp_cap.source: Cai T-type cap of Design5 / Design6: Design5 design5_layout.ENC with ENC_CAI (gap 12 um, plate 182 um) from the former Design4/layout/purcell_6500.py (git 289c7ea)

ref.note: Design5 / Design6 module as drawn (the 153.5 um measured in HFSS)

half.note: stub halved; line_spacing = 2 (stub_metal + W/2 + head_gap/2 + head_width)
